description: This file implements the SavedVariable class and related functions for managing saved autograd variables in PyTorch, including saving metadata, unpacking variables, and handling hooks.

classes.name: SavedVariable
classes.description: Class for saving and restoring autograd variables, including metadata and hooks, used during backward passes.

methods.name: SavedVariable::SavedVariable
methods.description: Constructor for creating a SavedVariable from a Variable, with options for output and in-place view.

methods.name: SavedVariable::save_metadata
methods.description: Saves metadata such as output number, version, and forward gradient.

methods.name: SavedVariable::get_default_hooks
methods.description: Retrieves default hooks for saved variables from the engine.

methods.name: SavedVariable::reset_data
methods.description: Resets stored hooks, grad_fn, and data.

methods.name: SavedVariable::SavedVariable
methods.description: Overloaded constructor accepting an optional Variable.

methods.name: SavedVariable::unpack
methods.description: Restores the saved variable as a regular Variable, checking versions and hooks.

methods.name: SavedVariable::set_hooks_and_pack_data
methods.description: Sets hooks and packs data into the saved variable.

methods.name: SavedVariable::register_hooks
methods.description: Registers hooks for the saved variable.
